title: How every new patient gets followed up
intro: LeadPro answers every new patient request right away and keeps following up by text and email until your front desk confirms the appointment. It also wins back patients you haven't seen in a while. Your team still does what it does today: call, confirm and book.

sections.html:
Two jobs, clearly split

LeadPro does

  • Collects new patient requests from your website form, website chat and inbound calls
  • Answers every website enquiry with a text right away, and sends your team the details
  • Sends an instant thank-you text and email to every new patient request
  • Follows up for 3 days until your team confirms the appointment
  • Alerts your team on Day 4 if a new patient still hasn't answered
  • Alerts your team the moment a patient replies, or an existing patient reaches out
  • Wins back patients you haven't seen in a while, with emails, texts and an offer over about 3 weeks
  • Keeps every text and email in one inbox

Your team keeps doing

  • Calling every new patient back
  • Confirming and booking the appointment in your practice software
  • Answering patients' replies
  • Choosing which past patients get the win-back messages
  • One new habit: moving the patient's card after each call

On this page, “messages” always means both texts and emails. No double entry: moving the card is what tells LeadPro to start or stop messaging.

The flow at a glance

Blue boxes are LeadPro working automatically. Amber boxes are your team. The green box is the booked appointment. Scroll sideways on a phone.

Your team's daily routine

  1. Open the board

    Every new patient is a card showing the name, phone, email and where they came from.

    Where: Opportunities → New Patient Leads · Your team

  2. Call every new patient, newest first

    Start with the New Online Form Lead, New Website Chat Lead and New Patient Inbound Call columns. The patient already has a thank-you text and email. Can't reach them? Leave the card where it is: LeadPro keeps following up for you.

    Where: your phone · Your team LeadPro follows up

  3. Booked? Move the card to Appointment Call Scheduled

    Book the visit in your practice software as you do today, then drag the card. The new-patient messages stop.

    Where: Opportunities → New Patient Leads · Messages stop

  4. Existing patient? Move it to Existing Patient

    Your team gets an alert with their details, and they don't get the new-patient messages.

    Where: Opportunities → New Patient Leads · Your team, one drag

  5. Answer replies

    Texts and emails patients send back appear in one inbox, and your team gets an alert for each reply. Reply there, or call them.

    Where: Conversations · Your team

  6. Check Online Form Lead No Response

    These are new patients LeadPro couldn't reach after 3 days. You get an alert on Day 4; give them one last call.

    Where: Opportunities → New Patient Leads · Once a day

  7. Win back past patients

    Pick patients you haven't seen in a while and add them to the win-back follow-up. When one replies, the card moves to Reactivated Patient Response and your team is alerted.

    Where: Contacts · Win-back follow-up starts

sections.html:
Messaging rules built in

Office hours onlyProposed: Monday–Friday during your office hours, Eastern time. Nothing goes out at night or on weekends (see open items).
Replies stop the sequenceOnce a patient answers, the automatic messages stop and your team takes it from there.
Opt-out always honoredEvery text names the practice and ends with “Reply STOP to opt out.”
No medical advice, one offerMessages invite a call or a visit, nothing more. The only offer is the $50 gift card in the win-back messages; change or remove it on your review page.

Where things stand

Everything on this page is built in your LeadPro account and switched off. Nothing goes to a patient until you're happy with it. Here's how it goes live:

  1. You review the wording and answer the open items

    Change anything you'd like in the messages, and send us the answers below.

  2. We make your changes and send a test patient through

    We check every message arrives as written and stops when it should.

  3. We switch it on and walk your team through it

    Your front desk sees exactly which card to move and when.

Later, once this is running

After about two weeks of use we'll review the numbers on your KPI dashboard together. Your account also has a Review Request board ready for asking happy patients for a Google review; we can switch that on next. None of these are switched on now.
